content.short: 1delta is a non-custodial margin trading protocol with access to $10B in liquidity.
content.description: 1delta is a non-custodial margin trading protocol that taps liquidity from decentralized exchanges and lending protocols to enable margin trades in a single click. By aggregating diverse liquidity sources, it optimizes swap routing to deliver seamless, efficient trades. The project also plans to introduce limit and stop orders to strengthen risk management for margin positions. Additionally, users can explore yield farming strategies within the protocol, expanding DeFi opportunities and enabling more sophisticated strategies for margin traders.
